message.reasoning_content: need to determine crimes. Facts: Trespass (entering by force) and theft of gas cylinder valued 55 yuan. Theft of low value property: under 500 yuan, qualifies as theft? Chinese Criminal Law: Theft (盗窃罪) requires value over 500 yuan for criminal liability? Actually theft of any amount can be punishable, but small amount may be considered minor theft, but still theft. Also illegal entry (非法侵入住宅罪) maybe? Chinese law has crime of illegal intrusion into private residence (非法侵入住宅罪) under Article 245? Actually Article 245 is "非法侵入住宅罪" punishable up to 3 years. So the acts of entering by force (kicking door, lock picking) constitute illegal intrusion. Additionally theft of gas cylinder is theft. So multiple crimes: illegal intrusion and theft. Need to list statutory offense names without "罪". So "盗窃" and "非法侵入住宅". According to correction rule: list only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we output "盗窃;非法侵入住宅". Ensure format: [罪名]盗窃;非法侵入住宅<eoa>. Provide JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
